description: Example multi-camera configuration for a communal chess installation
room_layout: Cameras positioned around the chess board to ensure continuous visibility even when people walk through

cameras.description: Top-down view - highest priority, best angle for piece detection
North side of board - backup when overhead is blocked
South side of board - provides opposite angle from north camera
East side - phone camera using IP Webcam app

camera_sources.usb_cameras: Use integers 0, 1, 2, etc. for USB webcams
camera_sources.phone_cameras: Use IP Webcam app on Android - URL format: http://PHONE_IP:8080/video
camera_sources.meta_rayban: When available, use companion app to stream to local HTTP endpoint

recommended_setup: 1 overhead camera (ceiling mount or tripod) - highest priority
Position cameras to minimize blind spots
Ensure at least 2 cameras can see the board at any time
Test by walking around the board - system should auto-switch cameras
